explanations.title: Restrict config lookup paths
explanations.summary: Resolution rejects absolute, parent-traversing, and excessively deep target paths, keeping config lookup scoped to repository-relative paths.

explanations.title: Add cascading configuration
explanations.summary: Configuration now resolves from the repository root down to the target file’s directory. Strictness can only increase, `failOnP0` can only be enabled, and disabled rules accumulate; comment types and the inline-comment limit use the nearest value provided. Defaults apply when no config sets a value.

explanations.title: Validate config files strictly
explanations.summary: Config files are rejected if they are empty, exceed 64 KiB, contain unknown fields or trailing data, use an unsupported version, or provide invalid setting values. This prevents malformed configuration from silently affecting resolution.

explanations.title: Expose the new command
explanations.summary: `validate-config` is now recognized as a top-level command and included in the usage text.

explanations.title: Add config validation command
explanations.summary: The new `validate-config` command reads applicable config files under the selected root, resolves them for a target path, and prints the effective settings as JSON. It reports read or validation errors instead of producing a result.
